a: अपटांतर — a. 1 Not separated (by a curtain or screen). --2 Adjoining, contiguous (= अपदांतर).

s: tri, (pawena vastreRa tiraskariRyA iti yAvat antaraM vyavaDAnaM yatra tat, tato naYsamAsaH .) AsannaM । saMsaktaM .) apadAntaraM । avyavahitaM । ityamarawIkAyAM svAmI ॥
v: tri॰ pawena tiraskariRyA antaramatra na॰ ta॰ । avyavahite, Asanne, saMsakte ca । apadAntaramityapyatrEvArTe ।
m: अ-पटान्तर mfn. ‘not separated by a curtain’, adjoining (v.l. अ-पदान्तर, q.v.), L.

s: strI, (alpaH pawaH alpArTe naYsamAsaH, gOrAditvAt NIz .) vastraprAvaraRaM । iti hemacandraH । kAnAt । iti BAzA । (yavanikA । parddA । ityAdi BAzA .)
v: strI alpaH pawaH pawI na॰ ta॰ । (kAnAt) iti KyAte kARqapawe vastraprAvaraRe sa ca “dUzyADolambivAyusaYcArArTaH paWaBeda” iti mallinATaH ।
m: अपटी f. a screen or wall of cloth (especially surrounding a tent), L.
a: अपटी — [अल्पः पटः पटी, न. त.] 1 A screen or wall of cloth, particularly the screen or kanāt surrounding a tent. --2 A curtain. --Comp. --क्षेपः (अपटक्षेपः) tossing aside the curtain; ˚क्षेपेण (= अकस्मात्) ‘with a (hurried) toss of the curtain’, frequently occurring as a stage-direction and denoting precipitate entrance on the stage which arises from fear, hurry, agitation &c., as when a character tossing up the curtain suddenly enters without the usual introduction ततः प्रविशति &c.

v: tri॰ nAsti pawI yasya kap । prAvaraSapawaSUnye, apagatA wIkAvyAKyAgranToyasya । wIkAjYAnaSUnye “apawIkojaqomAGe BfSaM jAqyena tAqyate” ityudBawaH ।

pu॰ apawyAH kARqapawasya kzepaH । prAvaraRapawakzepe । nAwyE hi prAvaraRapawe anyErAkzipte eva pAtrapraveSo'BinayasampradAyastamullaNGya pAtreRa yatra kARqapawaM svayaM kziptvA praviSyate tena cAkasmikatvaM tatpraveSasya gamyate । etatprayogaSca BariSo nAwakezu ।

m: अपटी—क्षेपेण ind. with a toss of the curtain, precipitate entrance on the stage (indicating hurry and agitation) (cf. पटीक्षेप.)

s: strI, (na pawuH, naYsamAsaH .) vyADitaH । rogI । ityamaraH । pawutArahitaH । kAryyAkzamaH । yaTA, -- “sA krAntA jaGanasTalena guruRA gantuM na SaktA vayaM dozEranyajanASrayErapawavo jAtAH sma ityudButaM” । ityamarukaviH ॥
v: tri॰ pawurdakzaH na॰ ta॰ । rogiRi, dakzatArahite, kAryyAkzame, dakzatAviroGimandatve ca । BAve tva apawutvam । apAwave । tal । apawutApyatrEva tvAntaM na॰ talantaM strI । guRavacanatvAt imanic । apawimA tatrEva pu॰ ।
m: अ-पटु mfn. not clever, awkward, uncouth
a: अपटु — a. 1 Not clever or skilful, slow, dull awkward, uncouth. --2 Ineloquent (as a speaker). --3 Sick.

k.v: ग्लानग्लास्नू आमयावी विकृतो व्याधितोऽपटुः। आतुरोऽभ्यमितोऽभ्यान्तः समौ पामनकच्छुरौ॥

m: अ-पटु—ता, f. or अ-पटु—त्व, n. awkwardness.
